methodology.training: Walk-forward rolling ridge regression using prior valid sessions only.
methodology.residual: Actual SOX return minus macro-baseline expected SOX return.
methodology.residualZ: Current residual standardized against up to 60 PRIOR model residuals only.
methodology.rateTransform: Parallel shock = (10Y bp change + 2Y bp change)/2; steepening shock = 10Y bp change - 2Y bp change. This reduces 2Y/10Y collinearity and makes rate sensitivity interpretable.
methodology.important: Same-day QQQ/macro changes make this a measured-response model, not a pre-open forecast.
